title: Murmurations: unexpected oscillations in elliptic-curve data
summary: Classification experiments and analysis of elliptic-curve data show oscillations in the mean of Frobenius traces that vary with rank. A numerical observation, not proof of a general law; the 2022 preprint was later published in Experimental Mathematics in 2024.
organization: Yang-Hui He, Kyu-Hwan Lee, Thomas Oliver and Alexey Pozdnyakov

evidence.tested: Classification experiments and analysis of elliptic-curve data show oscillations in the average Frobenius trace that vary with rank.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the arXiv abstract read.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning classification experiments were used to classify elliptic curves by rank.
